title: The Devoted Voices Beside a Prophet
intro: In a distant land, a noble messenger faced harsh rejection from the ruling powers of that era. Yet a small circle of devoted souls stood beside this servant of Allah, eager to answer a divine call. Their unflinching conviction would divide a powerful nation and ultimately prevail against the forces of disbelief.
clues: We were a small devoted group, united in faith and purpose.
We stood beside a noble messenger who was rejected by the powerful authorities of their land.
When this messenger asked, 'Who are my supporters in the cause of Allah?' we answered without hesitation.
We asked this messenger to seek a feast from the sky to bring reassurance to our hearts.
Among the people of that era, some believed through our message and others stubbornly refused, but Allah strengthened the believers.
We are the Hawwariyyun — the devoted disciples of Isa, made victorious through Allah's support.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Hawwariyyun (Disciples of Isa)
The Companions of the Cave
The Believing Wife of Pharaoh
The Royal Family of Saba
The Magicians who believed in Pharaoh's court

trial.label: Trial/Event

Being preserved in a slumber within a sealed cave
Being thrown into a blazing trench for faith

trial.answer: Pledging loyalty as supporters of a prophet's mission

location.label: Key Element
options: A table spread with heavenly food from the sky
A divinely built ship resting on a mountain peak
A staff that devoured the magic of tyrants
A cave sealed by divine protection
A she-camel that emerged from solid rock
location.answer: A table spread with heavenly food from the sky

options: Were made dominant over those who rejected the message

outcome.answer: Were made dominant over those who rejected the message

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
